# Overview

This notebook performs comparative analysis between the **human-AI** and **human-human** experimental conditions, focusing on valence alignment patterns.

**Key Questions:**
- Do exploration patterns differ between human-AI and human-human co-writing?
- How do effect sizes compare across conditions?

# Load Data

```{r load-data}

df_human_ai <- read_parquet(here("data/human-ai/processed/semantic_exploration_binned.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(condition = "human-ai",
         distance_log = log(distance)
)

# Load human-human data
df_human_human <- read_parquet(here("data/human-human/processed/semantic_exploration_binned.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(condition = "human-human",
         distance_log = log(distance)
)
         

df_combined <- bind_rows(df_human_ai, df_human_human)
df_interleaved <- df_combined %>%
  filter(agent == "interleaved") %>%
  mutate(
    # flatten list-column to character
    conversation_id = map_chr(conversation_id, as.character),
    # and treat it as a grouping factor
    conversation_id = factor(conversation_id)
)

```


```{r}

model_cross <- lmer(distance_log ~ k * condition + (1 | conversation_id), data = df_interleaved)


summary(model_cross)
```
